messages:
mira: Quick design review — attaching Figma frame (link) for the compact roles matrix inside the Invite drawer. Main asks: visual weight (rows feel dense?), SSO toggle placement, and a small pattern for 'jump to audit' from invite flow. Can y'all skim?

devin: saw it — overall looks tight. I think the compact spacing makes it hard to scan roles quickly. Recommend +6px vertical padding on rows and stronger dividers. also: column headers need clearer affordance for sorting.

kevin: agree w/ padding. also the focus ring on row selection is almost invisible at current token color. needs higher contrast or 2px border. hovering role rows the hover state is too subtle.

tara: small copy thing — the SSO toggle label says "Enforce SSO" which reads scary. Suggest "Require SSO for invited members" and put a short helptext link (?) that opens a modal with examples (e.g. when invites are blocked by domain).

sam: accessibility nit: tab order goes Invite email -> Invite button -> roles list. When screen reader user tabs they miss the role count and current selection. We should surface role summary with aria-live="polite" on change. Also the row checkbox doesn't announce role name + permission state.

ui-lint-bot: a11y scan: contrast fail on .role-meta (#6b6b6b on #ffffff) — ratio 3.2:1, target >= 4.5:1. Missing aria-label on SSO toggle.

mira: good catches. For the audit jump: idea is a small text link under the invite CTA "View related audit entries →" that opens the audit log scrolled to relevant filters (by org + actor). Thoughts on copy?

devin: copy ok but make it explicit: "View invite audit entries" — users search for "invite" more than "related". Also make it keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0).

kevin: technical constraint: deep-linking to audit log with pre-filled filters is doable, but landing UX should show a clear back link to the drawer. Otherwise users lose context. maybe open in a new panel?

tara: +1 to "View invite audit entries". Also request a tooltip on hover explaining retention windows (e.g., "Audit data retained 90 days for orgs on standard plan").

sam: for keyboard nav proposal: add a single skip link at top of drawer "Jump to roles matrix" that becomes visible on focus, and add role count announcement: "Showing 6 roles" when drawer opens. That should help SR users.

mira: implementation plan: 1) update spacing and divider tokens (+6px), 2) increase hover/focus contrast for rows, 3) change SSO copy + add aria-label, 4) add "View invite audit entries" link with deep-link + back breadcrumb, 5) add aria-live count + skip link. I'll make a follow-up PR with mocks and the a11y checklist.

devin: thanks — can you also include two micro variants in the mock: "compact with icons" vs "spacious without icons" so PM can A/B quickly.

kevin: I'll check with eng about the deep-link panel tradeoffs. If we can't do panel, we can anchor to audit and add a toast with "Back to Invite drawer".

tara: one more micro copy nudge: invite CTA tooltip should read "Enter emails or paste list (one per line)" instead of current "emails" to reduce errors.

mira: noted — will update. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

ui-lint-bot: reminder: run axe after updates — send results to #eng-oncall if new failures appear.
